name: Collabora Online
description: Integrates Collabora Online (LibreOffice-based) for in-browser document viewing and editing (WOPI).
project_description:
The Collabora Online module (COOL) allow integrating the Collabora Online productivity software into your Drupal CMS. Both the CODE (community release) and paid license versions are supported. COOL is an online office suite based on LibreOffice, that allow collaborative (simultaneous) editing and is compatible with Open Document and MS Office files. It is licensed under MPL-2.

 

 Features 
 Seamlessly allow viewing and editing office files in Drupal. Use your Drupal user database for permissions.

 

 You can view it inline from a post.

 

 Post-Installation 
 You need to have a Collabora Online server setup to use this module. The server doesn't not need to be exclusive to this setup.

 

 Additional Requirements 
 Requires the JWT and Media modules. This should be handled automatically.
